# Status assignments

```{r status_assignments}
# Load nativeness predictions from NIClassify + BLAST mapping
status <- read.csv(here::here("NIClassify/06_NIClassify_predict.csv")) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  dplyr::rename(zotu_id = upid) |>
  filter(str_detect(zotu_id, "Zotu")) |>
  select(zotu_id, status_final = final_status, status_ni = predict)

# Load BLAST/IBIS predictions from Excel (manual curation)
status_blast <- read.xlsx(here::here("data", "tax_invasive.xlsx"), sheet = "taxonomy")  |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  select(zotu_id, status_genus)

# Combine and clean all nativeness assignments
status <- status |>
  left_join(status_blast, by = "zotu_id") |>
  dplyr::rename(ibis_status = status_final) |>
  # Convert blank strings to NA
  mutate(across(c(ibis_status, status_ni, status_genus),
                ~ ifelse(.x == "", NA_character_, .x))) |>
  # Normalize case and rename columns for clarity
  mutate(
    Ibis      = tolower(ibis_status),
    NiClassify= tolower(status_ni),
    Blast     = tolower(status_genus),
    zotu_id   = tolower(zotu_id)
  ) |>
  select(-contains("status"))  # drop original status columns
```

# Figure 4: ASV sharing among tree species

```{r tree_presence}
# 1. Filter metadata to samples from the co-occurring tree comparison (ʻŌhiʻa, Koa, Guava on Oʻahu)
meta_leke <- meta_data |>
  filter(tolower(island) == "oahu") |>
  filter(str_detect(sample_id, "O_|K_|G_")) |>   # O = ʻŌhiʻa, K = Koa, G = Guava
  select(sample_id, sample_site, commonname)

# 2. Convert ZOTU table to long format, join tree metadata
zotu_long <- zotu_df |>
  inner_join(meta_leke, by = "sample_id") |>
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("zotu"), names_to = "zotu", values_to = "count") |>
  filter(count > 0) |>             # ← This is key
  distinct(zotu, commonname) |>    # ← Ensure no duplicate combinations
  mutate(present = TRUE)

# 3. Build presence/absence matrix per tree species (commonname)
zotu_presence <- zotu_long |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = commonname, values_from = present, values_fill = FALSE) |>
  inner_join(status |> select(zotu_id, NiClassify, Blast), by = c("zotu" = "zotu_id")) |>
  mutate(
    NiClassify = tolower(coalesce(NiClassify, "unknown")),
    Blast      = tolower(coalesce(Blast,      "unknown")),
    NiClassify = factor(NiClassify, levels = c("native", "introduced", "unknown")),
    Blast      = factor(Blast,      levels = c("native", "introduced", "unknown")))
```

```{r tree_upset, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=12}
# Tree ASV intersections colored by NIClassify nativeness predictions


# 4. Color palettes
niclassify_colors <- c(native = "#377EB8", introduced = "#E41A1C", unknown = "grey70")

# 5. Tree-specific colors
plant_colors <- c(
  "ʻōhiʻa Lehua"  = "#C1133D",   # ʻōhiʻa Lehua
  "koa"   = "#8B4513",   # koa
  "strawberry guava" = "gold"       # strawberry guava
)

# 6. NIClassify Upset with colored matrix
ni_leke <- upset(
  zotu_presence,
  intersect = c("ʻōhiʻa Lehua", "koa", "strawberry guava"),
  name = "Shared ASVs",
  width_ratio = 0.15,

  # Bottom matrix: colored by tree species
  matrix = (
    intersection_matrix(
      geom = geom_point(shape = "circle filled", size = 3)
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = plant_colors,
      guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 16, linetype = 0))
    )
  ),

  # Queries: row highlight stripes
  queries = list(
    upset_query(set = "ʻōhiʻa Lehua",     fill = plant_colors[["ʻōhiʻa Lehua"]]),
    upset_query(set = "koa",              fill = plant_colors[["koa"]]),
    upset_query(set = "strawberry guava", fill = plant_colors[["strawberry guava"]])
  ),

  # Top barplot: colored by NIClassify with totals
  base_annotations = list(
    "Intersection size" = (
      ggplot(mapping = aes(x = intersection, fill = NiClassify)) +
        geom_bar(color = "black") +
        geom_text(
          aes(label = after_stat(count), group = 1),
          stat = "count",
          vjust = -0.4,
          size = 4,
          fontface = "bold",
          color = "black"
        ) +
        scale_fill_manual(
          values = niclassify_colors,
          name   = "NIClassify",
          breaks = c("native", "introduced", "unknown"),
          drop   = FALSE
        ) +
        labs(x = NULL, y = "Summed ASVs") +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
        theme(
          axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          legend.position = c(0.8, 0.85),
          legend.justification = c(1, 1),
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.7), color = NA)
        )
    )
  )
)


# 8. Save main UpSet figure

save_fig(
  tag = "F4_tree_comparison_niclassify",
  plot = ni_leke,
  which = "main",
  prefix = "none",
  width = 8,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 600
)
```

# Figure S2: Comparison of status assignments

```{r classifier_symmetry_test}
paired_status <- zotu_presence |>
  filter(!is.na(NiClassify), !is.na(Blast)) |>
  select(zotu, NiClassify, Blast) |>
  mutate(
    NiClassify = factor(NiClassify, levels = c("native", "introduced", "unknown")),
    Blast      = factor(Blast,      levels = c("native", "introduced", "unknown"))
  )

paired_long <- paired_status |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(NiClassify, Blast), names_to = "classifier", values_to = "status") |>
  group_by(zotu) |>
  filter(n_distinct(classifier) == 2) |>  # Each zotu must have both classifiers
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    zotu       = factor(zotu),
    classifier = factor(classifier, levels = c("NiClassify", "Blast")),
    status     = factor(status, levels = c("native", "introduced", "unknown"))
  )

symm_test <- coin::symmetry_test(
  status ~ classifier | zotu,
  data = paired_long,
  teststat = "quad",
  distribution = "asymptotic"
)

symm_test
```

```{r classifier_confusion}
# Calculate confusion matrix
conf_mat <- zotu_presence |>
  dplyr::count(NiClassify, Blast) |>
  mutate(
    NiClassify = factor(NiClassify, levels = c("native", "introduced", "unknown")),
    Blast = factor(Blast, levels = c("native", "introduced", "unknown"))
  )

# Heatmap of the confusion matrix
conf_mat_plot <- ggplot(conf_mat, aes(x = Blast, y = NiClassify, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), fontface = "bold", size = 5, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#ffffff", high = "#b2182b", name = "Count") +
  labs(
    x = "BLAST Status",
    y = "NIClassify Status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

conf_mat_plot

save_fig(
  tag = "S2_classifier_confusion",
  plot = conf_mat_plot,
  which = "supp",
  prefix = "none",
  width = 12,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)
```

# Figure S8: Native and introduced ASVs across elevation bands

```{r elevation_status_presence}
# Use the Jenks elevation bands supplied by 00_source.R
ohia_meta <- meta_data %>%
  filter(tolower(island) == "oahu",
         !sample_id %in% c("KT1", "KA5"),
         shortname == "Ohia") |>
  distinct(sample_id, sample_site, elevation_m, elev_band)

# Merge with ZOTUs and NIClassify status
plot_meta <- zotu_df %>%
  inner_join(ohia_meta, by = "sample_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(-c("sample_id", "elev_band", "sample_site"), names_to = "zotu", values_to = "count") %>%
  filter(count > 0) %>%
  distinct(sample_id, zotu) %>%
  left_join(status %>% select(zotu_id, NiClassify), by = c("zotu" = "zotu_id")) %>%
  left_join(ohia_meta, by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(
    NiClassify = factor(
      if_else(NiClassify == "introduced", "introduced", "native"),
      levels = c("native", "introduced")
    ),
    elev_band = factor(elev_band, levels = c("Low", "Mid", "High"))
  ) %>%
  drop_na(NiClassify)
```

```{r elevation_status_plot}
# Count number of unique samples per group
sample_counts <- plot_meta %>%
  distinct(sample_id, sample_site, elev_band) %>%
  group_by(sample_site, elev_band) %>%
  summarise(sample_n = n(), .groups = "drop")


# Make short names for x-axis labels if needed
elev_df <- plot_meta %>%
  group_by(sample_site, elev_band, NiClassify) %>%
  summarise(zotus = n_distinct(zotu), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(sample_site, elev_band) %>%
  mutate(pct = zotus / sum(zotus)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(sample_counts, by = c("sample_site", "elev_band")) %>%
  mutate(
    x_label = paste0(sample_site, " ", elev_band, " (n=", sample_n, ")")
  )

# Explicit order for sites and elevation bands
x_levels <- elev_df %>%
  distinct(sample_site, elev_band, x_label) %>%
  arrange(
    factor(sample_site, levels = c("Kaʻala", "Schofield-Waikāne", "Poamoho", "Mānana", "ʻAiea")),
    factor(elev_band, levels = c("low", "mid", "high"))
  ) %>%
  pull(x_label)

elev_df <- elev_df %>%
  mutate(x_label = factor(x_label, levels = x_levels))


# Plot
invasion_ele <-
ggplot(elev_df, aes(x = x_label, y = pct, fill = NiClassify)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8, position = "stack", color = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(native = "#377EB8", introduced = "#E41A1C"),
    name   = "NIClassify Status"
  ) +
  labs(
    x     = NULL,
    y     = "Percent of ASVs"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
)


save_fig(
  tag = "S8_elevation_invasion",
  plot = invasion_ele,
  which = "supp",
  prefix = "none",
  width = 12,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r elevation_status_gee}
# Build summary: one row per sample_id × site × elevation band
inv_by_sample <- plot_meta %>%
  group_by(sample_site, sample_id, elev_band) %>%
  summarise(
    introduced = sum(NiClassify == "introduced"),
    native     = sum(NiClassify == "native"),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

# Add ridge_id for clustering (1:5 for your ridges, order as in your plot)
inv_by_sample <- inv_by_sample %>%
  mutate(
    ridge_id = as.numeric(factor(sample_site, levels = c("Kaʻala", "Schofield-Waikāne", "Poamoho", "Mānana", "ʻAiea")))
  )

gee2 <- geepack::geeglm(
  cbind(introduced, native) ~ elev_band,
  id = ridge_id,
  data = inv_by_sample,
  family = binomial,
  corstr = "exchangeable"
)
summary(gee2)
```


# Figure 5: Introduced ASV proportions among tree species

```{r tree_introduced_contrasts}
# 1) Re-compute per-sample proportions (introduced out of all classified+unclassified)
prop_df <- zotu_df %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample_id, names_to="zotu", values_to="count") %>%
  filter(count > 0) %>%
  distinct(sample_id, zotu) %>%
  left_join(
    meta_data %>% select(sample_id, sample_site, shortname),
    by = "sample_id"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    sample_site %in% c("ʻAiea","Mānana"),
    shortname   %in% c("Ohia","Koa","Guava")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    status %>% select(zotu_id, NiClassify) %>% rename(zotu = zotu_id),
    by = "zotu"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    NiClassify = coalesce(NiClassify, "unclassified"),
    NiClassify = factor(NiClassify, levels=c("native","introduced","unclassified"))
  ) %>%
  count(sample_id, sample_site, shortname, NiClassify) %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(NiClassify=="introduced") %>%
  transmute(
    sample_id,
    sample_site,
    tree        = recode(shortname,
                         "Ohia"  = "ʻōhiʻa Lehua",
                         "Koa"   = "koa",
                         "Guava" = "strawberry guava"),
    prop_intro = n / total
  )

# 2) Define the 3 pair-wise comparisons
comparisons <- list(
  c("ʻōhiʻa Lehua","koa"),
  c("ʻōhiʻa Lehua","strawberry guava"),
  c("koa","strawberry guava")
)

# 3) Build the bar + SE plot with significance stars
fig04_tree_intro <- ggplot(prop_df, aes(x = tree, y = prop_intro, fill = tree)) +
  geom_bar(stat="summary", fun="mean", width=0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(stat="summary", fun.data=mean_se, width=0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ sample_site, nrow = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(accuracy=1),
    limits = c(0,1), breaks = seq(0,1,0.2), expand = c(0,0)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = plant_colors) +
  stat_compare_means(
    aes(label = ..p.signif..),
    method           = "t.test",
    comparisons      = comparisons,
    p.adjust.method  = "holm",
    hide.ns          = FALSE,
    tip.length       = 0.01
  ) +
  labs(
    x        = "Tree species",
    y        = "Mean % introduced ASVs ± SE",
    fill     = "Tree"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x    = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1),
    legend.position= "none",
    strip.text     = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

save_fig(
  tag = "F5_ohia_koa_guava_comparison",
  plot = fig04_tree_intro,
  which = "main",
  prefix = "none",
  width = 9,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 600
)


fig04_tree_intro
```
